landing.title: Turn everyone's memories into something they'll keep forever.
landing.subtitle: Create a beautiful collection of voice messages, stories, photos, and memories from the people who matter.
landing.step1Body: Tell us who it's for. It takes a minute.
landing.step2Body: Send it on WhatsApp or by email. Nobody needs an account.
landing.step3Body: Friends and family record a message, write a note, or add a photo from their phone.
landing.step4Body: We gather everything into one beautiful page you can share, download, or keep.
landing.footer: Made so that anyone can say something meaningful.
landing.demoNote: We still laugh about that summer on the roof.
